exposure: FIGO grade of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) pathology
cohort: The study included 128 pregnancies with suspected or proven placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) pathology, delivered at a single institution between June 2012 and July 2024.
finding: The adjusted mean Fetal Fraction (FF) was significantly lower in the low FIGO grade placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) group compared to the high FIGO grade PAS group (9.3% vs 11.1%; p=0.03).
